_approach: The full stop is dariacore's most quoted structural signature — production write-ups describe 'sudden full stops' and 'meme-y drops or fake-outs for shock value.' This groove is a maximal breakbeat pattern for a bar and a half that then cuts to complete silence for the last two 16ths of bar 2 before the loop restarts hard on beat 1 — the drum-only version of the joke; the real fake-out obviously depends on what sample or silence gets edited into that gap, which drums alone can't supply.
